newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures close little lower.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures close little lower.

text.p: CME lumber futures held in a narrow trading range and generally finished with small losses as the cash market remained quiet, traders said.
Lumber closed mostly $1.40 to $0.40 per tbf lower with May off $0.80 at $372.90 and July off $1.00 at $367.20 per tbf.

Initial carryover demand from Monday's technical run up and limit gain in May failed to attract follow through interest and futures turned lower on mixed selling pressure. Continued slow cash trade weighed on sentiment, traders said.
Expectations demand for wood would rise soon as the spring home building season gets under way lent support, they added.
